title: debug_replay seeds unmasked entity ids into a masked replay; learned heat-loss learners reset
claim: On the owner's bundle, debug_replay.seed_stores writes 4 store-held entity ids that name no entity of the masked replay half, and over the 18-cycle window the replayed coordinator resets 2 learned heat-loss learners to the configuration ('its zone sensor changed') and warns 1 input unreadable; remapping those ids through the mask brings both counts to 0.
mechanism: export/the debugger mask every entity id in the replay half to its role (replay_doc), but seed_stores remaps only the store KEY onto FakeEntry's test_entry and copies each document verbatim; thermal_learning (heat-loss zone entities), dhw_legionella, off_restore and snapshots keep the install's real ids. On load, _void_heat_loss_learners compares the stored zone entities with the masked config, finds them changed and voids house_heat_loss_scale and lower_floor_loss_ratio, so every M5/M8 reproduction plans on configuration defaults rather than the install's learned house; the legionella restore watches an entity the replay never has and reports it unreadable.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, three arms in parallel with other seats, load1 55-280; counts, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tools/replay/debug_replay.py:seed_stores (counted through coordinator:HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._void_heat_loss_learners' WARNING and the integration's unreadable-input WARNING)

perturbation.change: --perturb remap-ids: before seeding, each store-held entity id is rewritten to the masked id the replay entry gives the same configuration key (the remap seed_stores omits)

metric_definition: Over the replay window: WARNING records voiding a learned heat-loss learner because its zone sensor changed, with the count of store-held entity ids absent from the masked replay half.
phenomenon_property: A replay seeded from a bundle's stores names, in every seeded document, only entities of the replay half it runs on; learned state the install held is the state the replay starts from.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 -c "import re,json,sys; sys.path[:0]=['custom_components']; from heatpump_optimizer import store; print(sorted(store.DOMAINS))" (each store document seed_stores copies; grep -n entity_id custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/{off_restore,legionella,thermal_model,snapshots}.py for the id-holding fields)

null_control.note: with every seeded id inside the mask no learner is voided and no input reads unreadable; the five replay judges read 0 in both arms, so the defect is invisible to the lane's own verdict

reproduction_steps: Run the command on the owner's bundle (window 18.5-23 h after the replay half's start, 18 cycles): seeded_foreign_entity_ids=4, learner_resets_zone_sensor_changed=2, unreadable_warnings=1, all five judges 0.
tools/replay/debug_replay.py --bundle B over the whole replay half logs the same two 'Learned ... reset to the configuration: its zone sensor changed' lines at its first cycle.
proposed_fix_scope: tools/replay/debug_replay.py:seed_stores maps every entity id in a seeded document through the replay half's mask (the replay entry's configuration keys give the pairs), or refuses to seed a document naming an id outside it; a gate_checks arm seeds a store holding a real id against a masked fixture and asserts no learner is voided.
